patch_description: Restructures the filter into a modular three-stage pipeline: (1) a Savitzky-Golay-style local quadratic fit evaluated at the window's leading edge for zero-lag trend estimation, (2) a 1D constant-velocity Kalman filter with innovation-gated adaptive measurement noise (rejects noise outliers, follows genuine dynamics), and (3) a slope-stability governor that damps output only when the estimated slope sign is unstable, directly targeting slope changes and false reversals. This separation of estimation, fusion, and stabilization concerns improves all four objectives simultaneously and keeps the architecture maintainable.
